evals.prompt: Be my chief of staff in Herdr. What needs my attention across my open panes?
evals.expected_output: Discover workspace/pane/agent state without mutating it; read selected evidence, distinguish recognized agents and shells, exclude self, and recommend a next step without treating done as delivered.

evals.prompt: Set up a chief in the top workspace, but leave my focus where it is.
evals.expected_output: Check for an existing chief first. If needed create without focus, start the chosen/current supported kind, supply skill and actual scope, verify readiness. Report unsupported top placement honestly.

evals.prompt: Ask the idle reviewer to review the search changes, and tell me when it is done.
evals.expected_output: Refresh target identity and foreground context, dispatch only the authorized review with bounded wait, inspect result, and distinguish reported findings from verified delivery. Do not approve dialogs or blindly resend a timed-out prompt.
